instruction: Make the body text of this slide bold.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully added a bullet point to the slide body text in LibreOffice Impress by clicking the text box, selecting all text (Ctrl+A), and clicking the Toggle Unordered List button in the Properties panel. Completed in 4 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with LibreOffice Impress UI, select text in text boxes, use Properties panel formatting buttons, apply text formatting
metadata.task_rationale: Since the model successfully applied bullet formatting, this variation tests a related text formatting operation (bold) using the same slide and interaction pattern.
metadata.explanation: Task requires making the body text bold. Getter reads the pptx file and checks the bold attribute of all runs in the body text shape (shape index 1). Metric returns 1.0 if all runs are bold.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly targets slide 0, shape 1 (body text) and extracts bold status of all text runs - semantically matches the instruction 'Make the body text of this slide bold'
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule': directly accesses expected.get('expected_bold', True) without wrapping in rules layer
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before evaluation, ensuring getter reads the latest state
Complete coverage: single instruction requirement (bold body text) is fully verified by the single getter+metric pair
